userStories.title: Migrate birdnet_recording.sh to Go
userStories.description: Create internal/recording/recording.go replacing scripts/runtime/birdnet_recording.sh (61 lines). Two modes: (1) RTSP mode: Parse comma-separated URLs from config, launch one ffmpeg subprocess per stream via exec.Command in separate goroutines with retry loop. Same ffmpeg args: '-hide_banner -loglevel {level} -nostdin -i {url} -vn -map a:0 -acodec pcm_s16le -ac 2 -ar 48000 -f segment -segment_format wav -segment_time {length} -strftime 1 {output}'. (2) Microphone mode: Launch arecord via exec.Command with '-f S16_LE -c{CHANNELS} -r48000 -t wav --max-file-time {length} --use-strftime {output}'. Check PulseAudio first. Config already loaded by internal/config/. Output to {RECS_DIR}/StreamData/. Support context cancellation for graceful shutdown. Add deprecation comment to old shell script (don't delete yet).
